race.comment: LEVENS HALL (11) was beaten just a nose last start when fresh from a spell and landed his first top-three finish in the process at Echuca over 1200m. Strips fitter and is a great chance to break through. RED LIGHT RACHEL (7) wasn't far off maiden success before a five-month break, finishing the prep with a minor placing at Swan Hill. Placed in a recent trial. Hard to beat if back in good order as anticipated. DUKE OF ZHOU (1) was in contention on the bend and progressed nicely last start to finish a close second over 1400m at Ballarat Synthetic after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Won't find this as tough so he is sure to be right there at the finish. LULL US AWAY (6) presents some value.
